cohort: Term, singleton, vertex pregnancies in patients without a history of cesarean delivery at a rural tertiary care center from January 2015 to December 2017
finding: Patients on the midwife service had significantly lower adjusted odds of cesarean delivery than patients on the obstetrician-led service.
mod_finding: This study found that women receiving midwife-led care had significantly lower adjusted odds of cesarean delivery compared to those receiving obstetrician-led care.
